reviewer: Codex primary implementer; independent audit remains separate

hunk_reviews.judgment: Review all24 hunks of the complete button-toggle spec migration. All73 static cases pair in full order,60 callbacks retain complete semantics and13 fakeAsync wrappers become ordinary callbacks.18 tick calls and two flush calls disappear; all73 predicates and other operations remain identical. Four setup wrappers change: three fakeAsync wrappers become synchronous and a waitForAsync(async-arrow) keyboard-event initializer becomes a synchronous callback. All seven hooks and17 fixture classes/templates are accounted for without claiming equivalent creation, ngModel propagation, event ordering, roving tabindex or lifetime. Changed observations cover model-before-change ordering, selected-value preservation after list replacement, indirect descendants, initial tabindex, removal of a selected toggle, exclusive/multiple/standalone change events and repeated clicks. Decline the private test preference and preserve owned historical legacy/standard button-toggle Sass and actual public-peer interoperability. Cyph imports MatButtonToggleModule and renders standalone and multiple toggle groups. There is no owned legacy button-toggle TypeScript family; do not create an ordinary component fork or infer inheritance from its absence. No product/API/HTML/CSS/SCSS change is required. Actual forms, event/focus, packed/consumer and both-floor gates remain open.
